exposure: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) types (accreta, increta, percreta)
cohort: Patients diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) whose hospital records were reviewed at Combined Military Hospital, Kharian.
finding: Previous cesarean sections were identified as a significant risk factor for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), and overall, the Postoperative Morbidity Index (PMI) and Comprehensive Complication Index (CCI) scores indicated mild postoperative morbidity and complications.
mod_finding: A previous cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for Placenta Accreta Spectrum.
cross-section timing: Data reviewed from January 2022 to December 2024
